description: RCE allows an attacker to execute arbitrary commands or code on a target machine over a network.
misconfigurations: Passing user input to os.system() or eval()
recommended_actions: Never pass untrusted data to system shells or eval functions.

audience_guidance.student: RCE is the holy grail for hackers. It means they can run any command on your computer as if they were sitting in front of it.
audience_guidance.developer: Avoid system calls. If necessary, strictly validate input and do not use a shell wrapper. Avoid insecure deserialization formats.
audience_guidance.bug_bounty_hunter: Look for input fields that interact with the OS, test deserialization endpoints with payloads from Ysoserial, test file uploads.
audience_guidance.pentester: Obtain a reverse shell, escalate privileges, and pivot into the internal network.
audience_guidance.security_team: Run applications in highly restricted containers (e.g., read-only filesystems, dropped capabilities) to limit post-exploitation impact.
